field.label: Interface
field.help: Interface whose clients should be routed into mihomo. Interfaces without a rule here never reach mihomo at all.

field.label: Source
field.help: Leave empty to use the interface network. A CIDR (192.168.1.0/24) or an alias name is also accepted.

field.label: Scope
field.help: Which traffic of this source should use the selected outbound.

field.label: Outbound
field.help: Proxy group the traffic should egress through. Ignored when the scope is "direct".

field.label: Policy Routing
field.help: Auto: the plugin also creates the OPNsense side (interface, gateway, firewall rule) after you confirm a dialog. Manual: only the mihomo rules are written, you route the traffic yourself.
